facts.fact: Gide says Law No. 18-07 of 10 June 2018, amended by Law No. 25-11 of 24 July 2025, is after a compliance phase now being effectively implemented.
facts.system: Law No. 18-07 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Gide says the ANPDP has been fully operational since August 2023 and receives notifications and authorisation applications through its online platform.
facts.system: Autorite Nationale de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel (ANPDP)

facts.fact: Gide names four ANPDP deliberations, dated 24 December 2025, 25 February 2026, 4 March 2026 and 6 May 2026, setting rules on data protection officers, health data, workplace video surveillance and biometric attendance control.
facts.system: Autorite Nationale de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel (ANPDP)
